derived_by: TWO provenances, deliberately separate. (1) 3508 names: the index census of model.language_model.layers.45, every key verbatim from weight_map, identical to glm53flash-turbo-2.05bpw-layer45-unexpected-keys.json. (2) 144 names: this release ships its VISION attention twice -- a fused attn.qkv.{weight,bias} transformers binds (48 keys, confirmed against a meta-device Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration skeleton which expects 48 fused and ZERO split q_proj) and a split exl3-quantized copy it never binds. Of the 144: 72 are verbatim index keys (model.visual.blocks.N.attn.{q,k,v}_proj.bias) and 72 are payload-group stems plus '.weight', the name exl3hf_surface.decode_payload_hf materializes from each {mul1,suh,svh,trellis} group; every stem was verified to carry all four parts in the index.
corroboration: the failed 2026-09-06 capture printed 'extra=144' and 'unexpected 3652'; 3508 + 144 = 3652 exactly, and the six names it printed are the first six of this sorted list byte for byte.
relation_to_bf16_allowlist: the non-expert names are the MTP block Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration never builds (text_config.num_hidden_layers is 45); turboderp quantizes layer 45's routed experts as exl3 mul1 payload, so the census includes those payloads plus non-expert tensors; turboderp also quantizes lm_head (head_bits=5)
artifact_disclosure: the vision tower is effectively UNQUANTIZED in this build under the pinned transformers: the bound path is the fused bf16 qkv and the quantized split copies are never touched, so a naive bits-per-weight read of this release overstates how much of it is quantized.
